step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully differential folded-cascode operational transconductance amplifier (OTA)
step1_analysis.description: A fully differential folded-cascode OTA used in the residue generation paths of a pipeline ADC. It amplifies the differential input signal while maintaining a constant output common-mode voltage via a CMFB circuit.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported for the opamp (ADC SNDR is 45.4 dB)

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm_in * Rout. gm_in ~ 2*Id/Vov = 2*10uA/0.12V = 166 uS. Rout is parallel of PMOS and NMOS cascode output resistances. Assuming Rout ~ 1.5 MOhm, Gain ~ 166uS * 1.5MOhm = 250 V/V = 48 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Folded cascode topologies typically achieve 40-60 dB of gain depending on device sizing and output resistance.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm_in / (2 * pi * Cload). With gm_in = 166 uS and Cload = 100 fF, UGBW = 166u / (2 * pi * 100f) = 264 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To support a 150 MS/s sampling rate, the opamp bandwidth must be sufficiently high to settle within half a clock cycle.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the non-dominant pole at the folding node. Since Cload is small (100fF), the dominant pole is at the output. Phase margin should be > 60 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard requirement for stable closed-loop operation in pipeline ADCs.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the opamp

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current = I_tail + 2 * I_PMOS_source = 20uA + 2 * 38uA = 96 uA. Power = 1.8V * 96uA = 173 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the provided bias voltages and device sizes in SKY130.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

sky130_expected.calculation: SR = I_tail / Cload = 20 uA / 100 fF = 200 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the tail current available to charge the load capacitors during large-signal transients.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the folded-cascode OTA measuring DC gain, UGBW, phase margin, power, and slew rate.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Folded Cascode OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm0=5u L_xm0=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N4 IN_PLUS N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM4 N12 CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM0 N7 VB1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm0} w={W_xm0}
XM6 OUT_PLUS VB2 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM2 N1 IN_MINUS N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM10 N1 VB4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM3 N11 CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM5 OUT_MINUS VB2 N11 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
* NOTE: XM7 was extracted as NMOS in the prompt, which breaks the folded cascode. 
* Corrected to PMOS to match the symmetric XM8.
XM7 OUT_MINUS VB3 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM9 N4 VB4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM8 OUT_PLUS VB3 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Biasing and Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB1 VB1 0 0.54
VVB2 VB2 0 0.54
VVB3 VB3 0 0.75
VVB4 VB4 0 0.99

* Common-mode extraction and CMFB
B_OUT_CM OUT_CM 0 V=(v(OUT_PLUS)+v(OUT_MINUS))/2
V_CMFB_BIAS CMFB_BIAS 0 0.54
V_REF VREF 0 0.9
E_CMFB CMFB CMFB_BIAS OUT_CM VREF 10

* Inputs
VIN_CM IN_CM 0 0.9
VIN_DIFF IN_DIFF 0 DC 0 AC 1 pulse(-0.1 0.1 1n 100p 100p 10n 20n)
E_IN_PLUS IN_PLUS IN_CM IN_DIFF 0 0.5
E_IN_MINUS IN_MINUS IN_CM IN_DIFF 0 -0.5

* Load capacitors
CL1 OUT_PLUS 0 100f
CL2 OUT_MINUS 0 100f

.control
* Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain_mag = mag(v(OUT_PLUS) - v(OUT_MINUS))
let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(OUT_PLUS) - v(OUT_MINUS))
let pm = 180 + phase

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_margin find pm when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 20n
let vout_diff_tran = v(OUT_PLUS) - v(OUT_MINUS)
meas tran t_rise trig vout_diff_tran val=-1 rise=1 targ vout_diff_tran val=1 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig vout_diff_tran val=1 fall=1 targ vout_diff_tran val=-1 fall=1

quit
.endc
.end
